catholic-encyclopedia-1913-pyx: The pyx is the small vessel that carries the Host. This entry explains its forms, its materials, and its history. The tabernacle of the traveler: its jeweled lid guards the sacred Host within in gold and silver and shining gems.
a-house-boat-on-the-styx: Bangs imagines the great dead sharing a houseboat on the Styx: Shakespeare bickers with Napoleon while Charon collects the fares. Light, clever, and full of literary jokes. The afterlife as a men's club, the afterlife as a men's club.
